summary: INTG-006 found a real P0 retry-semantics defect on the ticketing Stripe webhook that it cannot fix inside its allowed file set. app/api/ticketing/webhook/route.ts verifies the signature correctly, but lib/ticketing/finalize.ts claimWebhookEvent inserts into ticket_stripe_webhook_events and that table stamps `processed_at timestamptz not null default now()` AT CLAIM TIME (supabase/migrations/20260821000000_reconcile_ticketing_foundation.sql:339-345). There is therefore no way to distinguish 'claimed' from 'completed'. Consequence: if finalizePaidOrder / markOrderFailedAndRelease / refundOrderTickets throws after the claim succeeds, the route returns 500, Stripe retries, claimWebhookEvent returns false on the 23505 unique violation, and the route answers `{ received: true, duplicate: true }` with NO processing. A paid ticket order can be permanently stuck unfinalized because a single transient database error consumed the event. This is the 'replay-safe completion and safe retry semantics' half of INTG-006 acceptance criterion 2 and it is NOT closed.
